verdict.rationale: Context.dev's browser-actions guide documents click, wait, and scroll actions performed before a single scrape/extract call, which covers basic pre-scrape interaction, but there is no evidence of form-filling (text input) actions or persistent authenticated sessions needed to actually get behind a login wall across multiple steps. missing for 10: explicit form-fill/type action support, session/cookie persistence across requests, and any documented login-wall workflow or example.
